title: quercus humilis subsp. lanuginosa
intro: Quercus humilis subsp. lanuginosa, commonly known as Downy Oak, is a subspecies of deciduous tree native to Europe, characterized by its broad, rounded crown and dense, downy leaves. The health benefits of Quercus humilis subsp. lanuginosa include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Quercus humilis subsp. lanuginosa, particularly its flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
